findings.finding: AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH carries axes.genericity_kind = unresolved and H4 frames the open choice as dense-open versus full-measure, while its conclusion is generic-quantified over a comeager set. Under VOCAB_ALIASES, comeager resolves to the canonical residual_comeager, so a linter bound to the alias registry reads a settled Baire kind where the axis says unresolved. The supplement's axis_registry agrees with 'unresolved' but its scalar_note describes the F0 value as 'provisional', which is not the token F0 carries. Semantics are recoverable from the registry, but F0 alone does not settle whether the scalar class's genericity kind is named; recommend aligning the axis token or stating explicitly that the class-level quantifier is comeager while the topology on the reduced data space remains F1-owned.

F0's conclusion_type.allowed and the four axes use only the alias spellings (strong_cosmic_censorship_C2/_C0, provisional_baire_residual), while the alias policy says canonical tokens (scc_c2_future_inextendibility / scc_c0_future_inextendibility) must appear in a new canonical artifact; F0 does not cite artifacts/formulation/VOCAB_ALIASES.json. The two variants carry explicit, decidable falsifiers, but the four class entries carry no falsifier field.
